rule_set_version.description: Independently deliverable rule-set version (SAFE-03). Bump on any rule data change; this string is recorded in safety diagnostics for traceability.

anti_cheat_indicators.description: DEFENSIVE config-only list of known anti-cheat product/service/module name fragments used to RECOGNIZE risky targets and BLOCK. Never used to disable, hide from, patch, or bypass anti-cheat.

online_only_flags.description: Known online-only / always-online mode flag fragments observable without evasion.

storefront_drm_indicators.description: Known storefront DRM wrapper/module name fragments observable without evasion.

allOf.description: Autonomy floor: only the controlled smoke target may auto-approve. A non-smoke entry MUST NOT set allow_offline:true, mirroring the B2 hook-discovery safety gate, so this engine's auto-Allow path cannot disagree with the B2 gate's refusal.

allowed_launch_modes.description: Launch modes this entry permits. An EMPTY list is rejected: the engine treats an empty allow-list as permitting NO launch mode (least-permissive / default-block), so a shipped rule must explicitly list every permitted mode.

acceptable_modding_postures.description: Modding postures acceptable for this entry (a favorable signal only; never overrides identity/anti-cheat/online/launch-mode). An EMPTY list is rejected: the engine treats an empty list as 'no posture acceptable' (forces Warn), so the permissive vs restrictive choice must be made explicitly in data.
